title: A service-named process runs a shell that runs python3
threat_model: An attacker who controls a network service makes it run a shell, and the shell runs an interpreter, so there is a shell and a python3 below the service's name.
notes: The sh is a direct child of the service, which is the case of shell_from_service, and unusual_ancestry leaves that case to it. The python3 below the sh is an interpreter below a service, which is the case of unusual_ancestry. Both are expected. interpreter_chain sees a run of 2 (python3, sh) that ends at nginx, below its minimum of 3, so no other alert is expected.
